# Command compatibility

Gedis currently exposes 30 top-level engine commands over RESP2. This table is generated from the same registry used for dispatch and `COMMAND`; each syntax lists only options implemented by Gedis.

| Group | Command | Supported syntax | Arity | Flags | Key positions (first/last/step) |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| connection | `ECHO` | `ECHO message` | 2 | fast | — |
| connection | `PING` | `PING [message]` | -1 | fast | — |
| connection | `QUIT` | `QUIT` | 1 | fast | — |
| expiration | `EXPIRE` | `EXPIRE key seconds` | 3 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| expiration | `EXPIREAT` | `EXPIREAT key unix-time-seconds` | 3 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| expiration | `PERSIST` | `PERSIST key` | 2 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| expiration | `PEXPIRE` | `PEXPIRE key milliseconds` | 3 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| expiration | `PEXPIREAT` | `PEXPIREAT key unix-time-milliseconds` | 3 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| expiration | `PTTL` | `PTTL key` | 2 | readonly, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| expiration | `TTL` | `TTL key` | 2 | readonly, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| generic | `DEL` | `DEL key [key ...]` | -2 | write | 1 / -1 / 1 |
| generic | `EXISTS` | `EXISTS key [key ...]` | -2 | readonly, fast | 1 / -1 / 1 |
| generic | `TYPE` | `TYPE key` | 2 | readonly, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| persistence | `BGREWRITEAOF` | `BGREWRITEAOF` | 1 | admin | — |
| server | `COMMAND` | `COMMAND [COUNT\|INFO [command-name ...]\|HELP]` | -1 | — | — |
| server | `INFO` | `INFO [section ...]` | -1 | — | — |
| sorted-set | `ZADD` | `ZADD key [NX\|XX] [GT\|LT] [CH] [INCR] score member [score member ...]` | -4 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| sorted-set | `ZCARD` | `ZCARD key` | 2 | readonly, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| sorted-set | `ZINCRBY` | `ZINCRBY key increment member` | 4 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| sorted-set | `ZRANGE` | `ZRANGE key start stop [BYSCORE] [REV] [LIMIT offset count] [WITHSCORES]` | -4 | readonly | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| sorted-set | `ZRANK` | `ZRANK key member` | 3 | readonly, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| sorted-set | `ZREM` | `ZREM key member [member ...]` | -3 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| sorted-set | `ZREVRANK` | `ZREVRANK key member` | 3 | readonly, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| sorted-set | `ZSCORE` | `ZSCORE key member` | 3 | readonly, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| string | `GET` | `GET key` | 2 | readonly, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| string | `INCR` | `INCR key` | 2 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| string | `INCRBY` | `INCRBY key increment` | 3 | write, fast | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| string | `MGET` | `MGET key [key ...]` | -2 | readonly, fast | 1 / -1 / 1 |
| string | `MSET` | `MSET key value [key value ...]` | -3 | write | 1 / -1 / 2 |
| string | `SET` | `SET key value [NX\|XX] [GET] [EX seconds\|PX milliseconds\|EXAT unix-seconds\|PXAT unix-milliseconds\|KEEPTTL]` | -3 | write | 1 / 1 / 1 |

A negative arity is the minimum accepted argument count, including the command name. Key positions use Redis's legacy first/last/step convention; `-1` means the final argument.

`REPLCONF` and `PSYNC` are connection-layer replication handshake commands, so they are tested and documented separately and are not included in the engine registry or `COMMAND COUNT`.

## Regression evidence

- Connection, discovery, and server commands: `internal/server/engine_test.go`, `command_info_test.go`, `info_test.go`, and `server_test.go`.
- Strings, generic keys, and expiration: `internal/server/strings_test.go` and `internal/store/keyspace_test.go`.
- Sorted sets: `internal/server/sorted_sets_test.go`, `internal/store/sorted_set_test.go`, and randomized indexed-skip-list tests.
- Persistence: `internal/server/persistence_test.go`, `internal/aof`, and startup recovery tests under `cmd/gedis`.

See the [conformance log](conformance.md) for the Redis 7.2.7 probe method and explicit compatibility boundaries.
